$comment: Hermetic e2e scenarios (ADR-024, design-testing §2.1, critique E1/E2/E4). Served by GET /__e2e/scenarios; POST /__e2e/scenario {id} applies `setup`; POST /__e2e/seed-claim {accessToken, scenario} builds `claim` through the real API. `expected` is what the API reports once the scenario has settled (`settle`), under policy v1.1-safe-ai. Outcomes that the pure engine decides are pinned by tests/decisionConsistency.test.js (the `dc` field names the DC test that checks the same factors). Satellite and weather are supporting evidence only: they never change `expected.outcome` (owner decision D1).
eventDate: UTC midnight of (today in UTC) minus eventDaysAgo days. eventDaysAgo 0 is today in UTC, so the satellite post-event window (event + 1 day) is not open yet (critique E1). The browser runs in Asia/Kolkata; compute dates in UTC.

settleRules.decided: claim.state is a decision state (verified, partially_verified, rejected, duplicate_area, out_of_limit, more_evidence_required) and every job is terminal or queued for later than 60 s from now (a rescheduled satellite re-check).
settleRules.held: claim.state is submitted, the assessment is held, and no decision-input job (ai_assessment, land_documents, official_land_record) or engine job is queued or running.
settleRules.held_after_recovery: as `held`, and the highest ai_assessment recoveryRound is `expected.recoveryRound` (critique E4: overallStatus moves between in_progress and waiting_for_review while the worker re-queues the dead photo check; wait for this state through GET /__e2e/claims/:id/inspect, not through the UI).

scenarios.name: No photos: more evidence is asked for (no model call)
Happy path: the worker verifies the claim with no verify call
Gemini 429 twice, then the photo check succeeds on its third attempt
Gemini 429 on every call: technical hold, two automatic recovery rounds, then a reviewer
scenarios.notes: Transitional states (critique E4): in_progress (progress.decision.held_retrying_checks) while a re-queued photo check is active, waiting_for_review between rounds.

scenarios.name: Gemini 503 (overloaded) on every call: technical hold, never an adverse decision
Gemini times out on every photo: technical hold
Gemini answers malformed output: technical hold, never 'more evidence'
scenarios.notes: malformed_response is retried (3 attempts in e2e) but is not an automatically recovered kind, so there are no recovery rounds.

scenarios.name: AI reads no damage: held for a reviewer (one review case), never rejected by the AI alone
Tenant with a lease and a land record: documents are read, the claim is verified
Tenant without documents: claimant rights stay optional under v1.1, the claim is verified
Claimed area beyond the parcel limit: out_of_limit
Overlap with another farmer's claim: verified under v1.1, flagged for admins only (critique E2)
scenarios.notes: seed-claim first creates and submits a neighbour's claim over the same parcel (a second farmer whose parcel has the same geometry). The farmer sees no detail of the neighbour's claim.

scenarios.name: Satellite analysis supports the loss: 'passed', supporting only; the decision does not wait for it
Event today (UTC): the decision is shown while satellite is still pending with a next check
scenarios.notes: Critique E1: eventDaysAgo 0, computed as a UTC date. With eventDaysAgo 1 the post-event window would already be open.

scenarios.name: Cloud over every scene: satellite inconclusive (cloud cover)
Satellite provider error: unavailable, re-checked later, decision unaffected
No clear vegetation change: satellite inconclusive, never 'failed'; AI damage still verified
AI reads no damage while satellite supports the loss: still held for a reviewer (satellite never decides)
Weather unavailable: the weather stage completes as 'unavailable, supporting only'; decision unchanged
